spoken_first_2s: तो आज मैं देखने वाला हूं इतने बड़े डीमार्ट में सिर्फ ₹5 की चीज खरीदता उनका

notes.hook: 'Aaj main dekhne wala hoon itne bade DMart mein sirf ₹5 ki cheez khareedta, unka reaction kaisa hoga?'
notes.what_goes_wrong: The payoff (the cashier counting coins) is narrated instead of shown, and it ends on a throwaway 'like kar dena'.
notes.reusable_pattern: A tiny-budget challenge in a big store ('sirf ₹5 mein DMart'): a price limit plus other people's reactions.
